ops.text: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund on a pro-rata basis any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only cause-based exits across a three-year term, so we have added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. If helpful, we can discuss 60 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 9.4 giving Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no Vendor convenience right during a committed term.

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
